# cato_roles (Data Source)

Lists matching custom and predefined roles, fetching all pages and preserving API name order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cato_roles" "custom" {
  # account_id = "123456"
  # sort_direction = "DESC" # Defaults to ASC by role name.
  # filter = {
  #   predefined = { eq = false } # neq is also supported.
  #   name = { eq = "Viewer", neq = "Excluded", in = ["Viewer"], nin = ["Excluded"] }
  #   id = { eq = "12345", neq = "67890", in = ["12345"], nin = ["67890"] }
  # }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Account to query. Defaults to the provider account_id.
- `filter` (Attributes) Optional role filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `sort_direction` (String) Name sort direction, ASC (default) or DESC.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Account identifier for this query.
- `items` (Attributes List) All matching roles in API sort order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `total` (Number) Number of matching roles.
